patch_description:
The current program uses CRZ gates with a shared parameter, increasing total parameters to 20, which reduces parameter efficiency from 0.07 to 0.05 and lowers the combined score from 0.72 to 0.68. Despite perfect accuracy across all splits, the additional parameters are not justified.

The prior 1-block CZ chain achieves identical perfect accuracy (1.00 train/val/test) with only 14 total parameters (2 unique shared params: ry_shared, rz_shared) and parameter efficiency of 0.07.

This edit reverts to that proven architecture: RY shared layer → RZ shared layer → linear CZ chain → RZ shared layer. This maximizes the score by maintaining perfect accuracy while minimizing parameters, yielding better parameter economy and generalization properties.
